moves.name: Neutral B (Thunderjolt)

moves.name: Side B (Skull Bash)
moves.notes: 25 on hit endlag. Second total frames is from the air. Startup is 5 from charge release. 2.1 base recoil damage.

moves.name: Up B (Agility)
moves.notes: Total frames is for one/two dashes ending on the ground. 0.9 base recoil damage on first dash, and 1.4 on second. Can grab ledges as early as frame 14.

moves.name: Down B (Thunder)
moves.notes: First total frames is if the bolt misses. Invulnerable on frame 26-35 if bolt hits and incurs 4.2 base recoil damage
